subject.declared_domain: The ROLE vocabulary of the archetype layer: fourteen agnostic role names (Source, Store, Producer, Transformer, Consumer, Sink, Gateway, Guard, Router, Trigger, Registry, Container, Observer, Custodian), each carrying a prose `derive:` rule stating the edge-shape that assigns it. It is the ROLE half of the archetype layer; #relations is the other half.

methodology.how: A hand-legislated YAML block, top-level key `roles:` at line 96. Each of the 14 members is a mapping with exactly one load-bearing field: `derive`, a PROSE sentence describing the edge shape that earns the role -- e.g. Source is 'no within-system inbound; outbound produces'. Nothing computes the block and nothing mechanically applies the derive rules; they are read by a classifier. A sibling top-level key `role_priority` supplies a 14-member precedence ORDER used when a node satisfies more than one derive rule. The block changes only by ratification plus a meta.version bump.
declared_opinions: ALL FOURTEEN derive rules are PROSE, not predicates. 'no within-system inbound; outbound produces' is a sentence a human applies; nothing in the estate evaluates it. THIS IS THE SEMANTIC AXIS IN ITS PUREST FORM -- the opinion is not buried, it is fully visible, and it is still unexecutable.

role_priority imposes a total order (Custodian > Observer > Gateway > Guard > Router > Registry > Trigger > Container > Transformer > Producer > Consumer > Source > Store > Sink). A node matching several derive rules gets the FIRST. That ordering is a judgement with no stated derivation and it silently decides every multi-match case.

Observer is annotated '(13th, CTO GRANTED)' and Custodian '(14th)' -- the vocabulary records that two roles were added by grant rather than derived, which is honest and is also an admission that the set is not closed by construction.

scope_outs declares Type/Symbol/Concept outside the role vocabulary, with Concept marked 'honest-degrade (no forced Role, counted in the denominator)' -- a deliberate refusal to force a role, and a good one.

composes.note: the block that maps roles DOWN to concrete node_types; roles alone assign nothing
the other half of the archetype layer per meta.layers.layer_2_archetype

invents.note: the fourteen role names; they appear in no producer and no graph field, only here
the prose assignment rules, originated here and evaluated nowhere
the total precedence order over the 14 roles

All 14 members and their derive strings read verbatim via yaml.safe_load. role_priority read as a 14-element list. determinism 'deterministic' is EXERCISED for the BLOCK: two yaml.safe_load parses give byte-identical member sets, and the block has no runtime, no inputs and no model. NOT CLAIMED: that APPLYING the derive rules is deterministic -- they are prose evaluated by a reader, and two readers could assign differently. That is a property of the rules, not of the block, and this card does not measure it.

coverage.universe: The role vocabulary available to classify every node in the estate graph.
coverage.denominator: 14 of 14 roles are declared with a derive rule -- none blank. Against the binding half: 10 of 14 roles carry a node_binding; 4 of 14 (Custodian, Producer, Router, Source) carry NONE, so those four cannot be populated from node_type by the declared map. Live reach, measured through node_bindings: 48 of 58 live node_types and 20,750 of 27,035 nodes (76.8%) sit under a bound role.
explicitly_out: Type, Symbol, Concept -- declared in scope_outs as outside the role vocabulary; Concept explicitly 'honest-degrade (no forced Role, counted in the denominator)', which is a refusal to force an answer and is the right call

the 4 roles with no node_binding (Custodian, Producer, Router, Source) are NOT declared out -- they are declared IN the vocabulary and simply unreachable from node_type, which is a different and weaker position
coverage.evidence: Counts computed from the materialised comp-kuzu node census joined in python against the block and against #node_bindings @5fc45ad69d. 14 declared roles; node_bindings carries 12 buckets of which 10 are role keys; set difference gives the 4 unbound. Live figures from 'MATCH (n) RETURN n.node_type AS t, count(*) AS n ORDER BY n DESC' -> 58 types / 27,035 nodes. THE 4 UNBOUND ROLES ARE THE FINDING AND THEY ARE NOT NEW -- my wave-1 C0 card measured the same four. What wave 2 adds is the direction: from the ROLE side it is 4 of 14 unreachable, which is a vocabulary-completeness statement; from the C0 side it was 23.2% of nodes unmapped, which is a population statement. Same defect, two denominators, and neither substitutes for the other.

failure_mode.returns_on_failure: The block is passive data; its failure surfaces at the LOADER. All 8 loaders use the same shape -- yaml.safe_load then a dict lookup. On a miss the lookup returns None, silently. A member that does not exist and a live estate object this block has not covered both yield the same None.
silent_degrade_paths: the stale v1.1 copy carries the IDENTICAL `ratified: LD-0311 @086238604` string as the canonical while `meta.version` reads 1.1 -- a reader checking provenance gets an authoritative-looking answer from a seven-version-stale file. RATIFICATION IDENTITY DOES NOT DISCRIMINATE VINTAGE.
the block has no cadence, so it can fall behind a nightly-moving estate indefinitely with nothing signalling the gap
a node satisfying several derive rules is resolved silently by role_priority's total order; nothing records that a tie occurred or which rules competed
the 4 roles with no node_binding can never be assigned from node_type, so a role-keyed traversal returns a confident smaller answer rather than an error
failure_mode.evidence: EXERCISED, THREE ARMS, on the lookup shape every loader uses. Inverting the block and querying: ARM A a declared member -> resolves (POSITIVE CONTROL: the lookup CAN answer); ARM B a live estate object this block does not cover -> None; ARM C a nonexistent token -> None. ARMS B AND C ARE BYTE-IDENTICAL, which is the finding; ARM A establishes the probe is live, so the two Nones are answers rather than a dead instrument. NOT EXERCISED, and named as such: I did not repoint a loader at the stale copy to watch it succeed -- that would mutate another seat's code and qualify-do-not-fix binds. That path is structural, and its precondition (no loader reads the copy) is measured.

verdict.why: All seven rows are worked, carry basis/evidence/owner and a basis_by_field where provenance is mixed; none is blank, so this is not INCOMPLETE. The block is internally complete -- 14 of 14 roles carry a derive rule -- and QUALIFIED on three measured limits: (1) 4 of 14 roles (Custodian, Producer, Router, Source) have NO node_binding and are therefore unreachable from node_type, so a role-keyed view of the estate spans at most 76.8% of nodes; (2) all 14 derive rules are PROSE that nothing evaluates, and role_priority silently resolves multi-matches by a stated order with no recorded derivation -- the semantic axis fully visible and still unexecutable; (3) a lookup miss returns a silent None indistinguishable from a genuine absence, exercised over three arms. NOT CLAIMED: that the derive rules are CORRECT, or that two readers applying them would agree -- this card measured that they exist, are complete and are prose, not that they discriminate. NO DEPRECATION VERDICT is expressed or implied, per W2-m-3.
